description.en:
Specifies whether to delete all tags under the template. Valid values:

- **true**: yes.
- **false**: no.

descriptions.zh:
### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为50次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
### QPS limit
The QPS limit per user for this operation is 50 calls per second. If the limit is exceeded, API calls will be throttled, which may affect your business. Please call the operation reasonably.
